steps.code: <?php require_once 'wordpress/wp-load.php'; $feed_url = 'https://apnews.com/hub/apf-topnews?format=rss'; $feed_id = md5($feed_url); $feeds = array($feed_id => array('feed_url' => $feed_url, 'interval' => 'hourly', 'author_id' => 1, 'status' => 'active', 'last_run' => null, 'last_result' => null)); update_option('newspack_lite_site_rss_importer', array('feeds' => $feeds)); wp_schedule_event(time(), 'hourly', 'newspack_lite_site_rss_import', array($feed_id));
